title: 第27章 草儿的病，我能治

第27章 草儿的病，我能治-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“柔雪，你这是做什么？快起来！”李青山微微一怔，连忙将身子孱弱的柔雪从地上搀起来道。

双手刚刚接触到柔雪的胳膊，李青山心中一紧。

这些年，柔雪恐怕是没少挨饿，这两条胳膊上都没什么都，极其瘦弱，平日里衣裳袖子都宽大一些能够遮盖住，看不出来，只有上手才能发觉道。

“青山，姐求你了，草儿快不行了！”

“这孩子跟着我没有过一天好日子，临走前，就想吃一碗肉，求求你了……！”

“让我干什么都行！”

柔雪孱弱的身子无力的倒在李青山怀中，苦苦哀求道。

“你女儿怎么了？”李青山关切问道。

“生了重病，快要不行了！”柔雪一副梨花带雨的模样，甚是惹人怜爱，忍不住想要搂入怀中细细安慰。

“前一段时间不还好好的吗？”

“你等会吧！”

“待会，我跟你一块回去看看！”

李青山接过柔雪手中的破碗，便朝着院子走了进去。

“啊……！”

柔雪听到李青山的话，脸颊升起一抹羞红，难不成李青山想要到自己家中，然后让自己伺候他？

可若是让女儿看到了，该如何是好？

罢了。

待会，只能让李青山动静小一些，莫要惊动了自己女儿。

自己没用。

没让女儿过上一天好日子，今日能够吃上这一口肉，也算是了却了自己女儿一个心愿。

很快。

李青山便用破碗端了一碗肉出来，上面还盖了三四个饼子，这饼子看起来可不是玉米饼子，好像是用面粉刚刚烙出来的饼子，还散发出一股淡淡的麦香味。

柔雪忍不住暗自咽了口口水。

旋即语气中带着几分感激道：“青山，谢谢你了！”

自己只是乞求李青山送一碗肉，然后自己用身子回报，却不曾想李青山还多送了几个饼子，还全都是小麦面粉做的，这可是细粮啊！！

整个石溪村，几户人家吃得起？

村支书家里都吃不上。

“走吧！”

李青山说罢，便跟着柔雪一起到了家中，推开门走了进去。

"Rou Xue, what are you doing? Get up!" Li Qingshan was slightly startled, and quickly lifted the weak Rou Xue up from the ground.

As soon as his hands touched Rouxue's arm, Li Qingshan's heart tightened.

In recent years, Rouxue must have been hungry a lot. There is nothing on these two arms, and they are extremely thin. Normally, the sleeves of her clothes are wider and can cover them, so they cannot be seen. They can only be noticed by touching them.

"Qingshan, sister, please, Cao'er is dying!"

"This child has never had a good day with me. Before he left, he wanted to eat a bowl of meat. Please...!"

"You can do anything you want me to do!"

Rouxue's frail body fell helplessly into Li Qingshan's arms, begging bitterly.

"What's wrong with your daughter?" Li Qingshan asked with concern.

"I'm seriously ill and I'm about to die!" Rouxue looked like a flower with a hint of rain. She was so endearing that she couldn't help but want to hold her in her arms and comfort her.

"Weren't you fine some time ago?"

"Just wait a moment!"

"I'll go back with you later to take a look!"

Li Qingshan took the broken bowl from Rouxue's hand and walked into the yard.

"Ah...!"

When Rouxue heard Li Qingshan's words, a blush rose on her cheeks. Could it be that Li Qingshan wanted to come to her home and let herself serve him?

But what should I do if my daughter sees it?

That’s all.

Later, he could only ask Li Qingshan to make less noise, so as not to disturb his daughter.

Useless to myself.

He didn't let his daughter live a good life for a day, but being able to eat this bite of meat today was like fulfilling her daughter's wish.

soon.

Li Qingshan brought out a bowl of meat in a broken bowl, which was also covered with three or four pancakes. The pancakes did not look like corn pancakes, but seemed to be pancakes freshly baked with flour, and they also gave off a faint smell of wheat.

Rouxue couldn't help but swallowed secretly.

Immediately he said with a hint of gratitude in his tone: "Qingshan, thank you!"

I just begged Li Qingshan to give me a bowl of meat, and then used my body to repay him, but I never thought that Li Qingshan also gave me a few more pancakes, all of which were made of wheat flour. This is a fine grain!!

How many families in the entire Shixi Village can afford to eat?

Even the village party secretary’s family couldn’t afford it.

"Let's go!"

After Li Qingshan said that, he followed Rouxue to his home, opened the door and walked in.
